name: display_split_shell_words
notes: Traced copy of display.c::_cli_split_shell_words vs LIVE _split_shell_words over 12 segments (quotes, empty quotes, mid-word quotes, runs of spaces, tabs). DOCUMENTED DIVERGENCE: LIVE keeps a quote open after a backslash-escaped quote and treats \x0b/\x0c as space — C does neither; such inputs excluded.
